note: Parity golden for the TS cascade plan (tools/almadar-pattern-sync/src/cascade/publish.ts publishCascade), recorded with ZERO side effects: child_process, every fs write, fetch and the network are stubbed by a recording harness that returns scripted answers (guard throws on any unstubbed API; proven on a sandbox repo and by unchanged git state of root + core/ui/db). Harness (scratchpad, not in repo): cd tools/almadar-pattern-sync && K4_OUT=<dir> node --import tsx <scratchpad>/k4/harness.mjs <scenario>; files guard.mjs, harness.mjs, substrate-stub.mjs, selftest.mjs. Each step is {n, phase, kind, pkg, argv, cwd, gate, wave}; kind execSync|spawnSync|spawn|fs-write|fetch|gate|exit. Scripted facts: registry answers every npm view with the local version and publishes a version once its tag is pushed, gh runs are all green, git has no divergence unless scripted, ORB_BIN is a stub. Excluded as incidental: orb-lower derived-cache writes of the behavior-package reader (~/.almadar/derived) and tsx's own cache/transform process. The SUBSTRATE gate is stubbed to pass in every scenario but substrate-live-tree (the live tree currently fails its dead-import rule). Concurrent publishes interleave deterministically (two runs diffed identical). Tree dependent: versions, tags and wave numbers follow the manifests at the recording commit.
